mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 6 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% suggests accommodative monetary policy, which generally supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 3 months signals strong consumer demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both RSAFS increases by more than 1% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during an economic expansion.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 during an economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous quarter signals robust economic growth and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both GDPC1 increases by more than 1% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.
